title: 1.4 Financial mathematics

q.Q2: Q2. KES 200 000 is invested at 5% per year compounded annually. Find its value after 6 years, to the nearest shilling.
q.Q3: Q3. KES 50 000 is invested at 4.8% per year compounded monthly. Find its value after 5 years.

q.Q4: Q4. A laptop costs KES 120 000 and depreciates by 20% each year. Find its value after 3 years.

q.Q5: Q5. A loan of KES 500 000 is repaid with monthly payments of KES 16 607 over 3 years. Find the total amount repaid and the total interest.

q.Q6: Q6. How many complete years will it take for KES 100 000 invested at 7% per year compounded annually to double?
